subject: Next steps & 30m product intro — scheduling options
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@voyanta.io>, Selena Ortiz <selena@voyanta.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps & 30m product intro — scheduling options

Hi Evan & Selena,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning — appreciate the transparent walkthrough of Voyanta's ingestion pipeline and the latency constraints you flagged. Quick recap from our side:
- Goal: evaluate Redwood as an inference runtime to reduce tail latency and cut per-token infra costs for your realtime scoring path.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 95th pct latency < 150ms on 4k seqs, private VPC option for PII data, and predictable costs for 24/7 traffic.

Next step I'd recommend is a short 30-minute product intro where we demo the runtime and call out the specific parts relevant to your architecture (KV cache, autoscaling profiles, and a short quantization tradeoff sketch). Can you confirm which of these 2–3 windows works for your team (all times PT):
1) Thu Mar 30 — 09:00–09:30
2) Thu Mar 30 — 13:00–13:30
3) Fri Mar 31 — 11:00–11:30

If you pick one, we'll invite the right internal engineers: Rishi will lead the technical deep-dive and Ava will cover onboarding + SLAs. If there's anyone else on your side who needs to join (platform/infra engineer or procurement), please add them.

I've attached a short post-discovery recap and your RFI we pulled together for quick reference.

Thanks — happy to be flexible on times if these don't work.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: post-discovery-recap-voyanta.pdf, voyanta-rfi.pdf

From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@voyanta.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-25T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & 30m product intro — scheduling options

Naomi — thanks, this is helpful. Selena and I reviewed the windows and Thu Mar 30 13:00–13:30 PT works best for us.

Please include our platform architect Selena (cc'd) and Carlos (our backend lead) — they'd like a 10-minute section on model sharding and how KV cache behaves under bursty traffic. If Rishi can cover that, perfect.

One ask: can you send a brief proposed agenda (2–3 bullets) so we can set expectations with execs? Also, curious if you can share the one-pager you mentioned before the call.

Evan Liu
Head of Platform, Voyanta
evan.liu@voyanta.io
(650) 555-4332

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Perfect — locking Thu Mar 30 13:00–13:30 PT for the 30-minute intro. Agenda (proposed, short):
- 5m: Quick intros & goals alignment
- 12m: Live demo focused on KV cache behavior, latency profile, and autoscaling options
- 8m: Q&A on integration points (model sharding, VPC/KMS) + next steps

Rishi will take the demo segment Rishi (technical) and Ava will cover onboarding and SLA/timelines. I'll send the calendar invite and attach the Redwood one-pager.
